title: MindDocs AI
short: Multi-modal AI system for document summarization, translation, and domain-specific RAG chatbots.
excerpt: Built multimodal document processing and RAG chatbots; integrated Azure Blob, LangChain and Hugging Face; deployed containerized services with CI/CD.
desc: End-to-end multimodal pipeline that ingests PDFs/images, runs OCR, creates embeddings and serves RAG-based chatbots and summarizers with multi-language translation support.
architecture: Ingest: Azure Blob storage + uploader microservice.
Preprocess: OCR (Tesseract / Vision encoder) → text normalization → chunking.
Embeddings & Indexing: Hugging Face embedding model → vector store (FAISS) with per-document metadata.
RAG + Orchestration: LangChain agents assemble context → open/closed-source LLMs for generation and translation.
Serving: REST/GraphQL API + lightweight frontend; asynchronous jobs for heavy preprocessing.
metric: 18% uplift in retrieval relevance (user-tested) · avg retrieval latency ~220ms
ops: Containerized microservices (Docker). CI/CD pipelines build images, push to registry, and deploy to Kubernetes. Uses Azure Blob for storage and automated nightly indexing jobs.

title: Tourist Buddy
short: AI-powered trip planner that generates budget-friendly itineraries, route maps, day-wise plans, weather insights, and expenditure breakdowns using agentic workflows.
excerpt: Built an agentic AI travel planner leveraging open-source LLMs, weather + map APIs, DuckDuckGo search and web scraping. Generates optimized itineraries, routes, daily plans, and budget estimates end-to-end.
desc: Agent-driven itinerary generator that combines LLM reasoning, real-time API data (maps, weather, pricing), and optimization heuristics to produce multi-day travel plans tuned for budget and preferences.
architecture: Frontend: React SPA for input + itinerary preview.
API Layer: FastAPI exposes endpoints for itinerary generation and session management.
Agent Stack: LangChain + LangGraph orchestrate sub-agents (places, transport, budget, weather).
Data: Live API calls (Maps, Weather) + cached scraped POIs; embeddings for user preferences.
Optimizer: Simple constraint solver for time/budget tradeoffs; route generation using Maps API.
metric: Generates full 3-day itineraries in ~6s; early user tests show high usefulness (avg satisfaction 4.6 / 5).
ops: Microservices packaged with Docker; CI builds to container registry. Can be deployed to managed containers (Cloud Run / ECS) with scheduled cache refresh jobs.

title: AI Chatbot — Resident's Manual (AIIMS)
short: Domain-specific LLM chatbot for hospital residents; achieved 92% accuracy on domain queries.
excerpt: Custom LLM chatbot for medical QA using FAISS and retrieval-augmented generation.
desc: Specialized retrieval-augmented chatbot tuned for medical residents, focused on high-precision answers for procedural and policy queries from the hospital manual.
architecture: Data ingestion: Convert resident manual PDFs → structured passages with metadata.
Indexing: Sentence/document embeddings → FAISS index with section tags.
Model: Lightweight BERT-based ranker + PyTorch-backed reader/generation model in RAG loop.
Safety: Heuristic filters + citations returned with answers for verification.
UX: Web-based chat UI that surfaces source passages and confidence score.
metric: 92% accuracy on internal domain QA benchmark; 85% of answers include exact source citation.
ops: Containerized (Docker) with CI that runs tests and pushes images. Deployable to Kubernetes or VM; periodic re-indexing pipeline for manual updates.

title: Legal Sage
short: Legal document summarization and multi-language translation toolkit (BERT / T5).
excerpt: Fine-tuned BERT/GPT-2/T5 for summarization and structured extraction pipelines for legal professionals.
desc: Toolkit to summarize legal contracts and extract structured clause-level information with optional multi-language translation for cross-jurisdiction review.
architecture: Preprocessing: spaCy pipelines for tokenization, NER, and clause segmentation.
Models: Fine-tuned T5 / GPT-2 for abstractive summaries; classifier heads for clause tagging.
Postprocess: Rule-based validators to convert summaries into structured JSON (parties, dates, obligations).
Integration: CLI + REST wrapper for batch processing of document sets.
metric: Clause-extraction F1 ≈ 0.91 on internal test set; summaries reduced manual review time by ~40% in trials.
ops: Packaged as Docker images; recommended deployment on private infra for confidentiality. CI runs unit + integration tests; supports on-prem or cloud VM deployment.

title: MeetScheduler
short: AI-powered Google Workspace meeting scheduling agent built on Google Cloud Platform.
excerpt: Built an intelligent agent on Google Cloud that automates scheduling, notifying attendees, blocking calendars, and managing Google Meet and Calendar events end-to-end.
desc: Automates meeting scheduling across Google Workspace accounts using heuristics + small LLM prompts to infer meeting preferences and availability.
architecture: Trigger: webhook / App Script when a scheduling request arrives.
Scheduler: Service queries Google Calendar & runs conflict-resolution heuristics.
Notifications: Gmail API for invites; Google Meet link automatic creation.
Agents: Webhook agents handle follow-ups, rescheduling, and cancellations.
Audit: Logs and event history stored for traceability.
metric: Automated ~80% of routine scheduling flows in test pilot; reduces human scheduling time by ~30%.
ops: Hosted on GCP (Cloud Run / App Engine) with service account-based auth. CI/CD for deployments and infra-as-code for service bindings.

title: Artimacy
short: E-commerce platform for handicrafts, artworks and sketches — an early front-end project showcasing responsive UI and product listing UX.
excerpt: Initial handcrafted e-commerce site built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS: product pages, responsive layout, cart simulation, and basic client-side interactions.
desc: MVP front-end store demonstrating layout, responsive gallery, product cards and a simulated cart for showcasing artwork listings.
architecture: Static frontend: responsive pages with modular components (product card, gallery, cart).
Client-side state: JS-based cart and filter logic (no backend in MVP).
Assets: Optimized images and lazy-loading for performance.
Extensibility: Designed to plug into any REST backend or headless CMS later.
metric: MVP completed; responsive layouts consistently under 500ms on local tests; early usability tested with a small group (5 users).
ops: Static site deployable on Netlify / Vercel or any static host. No CI required for MVP—CI/CD added when connecting to a backend.
